mechanism_narrative: The WORKPLACES weekly mean rebounded 5.9 points from -21.0 at t-1w to -15.1 at t-0w, restoring weekday commuting flows and the lunchtime and after-work shopping trips they carry, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks relative to the last four.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES weekly mean moved from -21.0 at t-1w to -15.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averaged over the 28 days after 2022-07-15 is at or below its average over the preceding 28 days despite the WORKPLACES rebound of 5.9 points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has been pinned below -39 for four consecutive weeks, which starves CBD and station-adjacent retail catchments of foot traffic; with no transit revival in the series, RETAIL_REC falls further over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean stays below -35.0 for four consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly means -39.3, -40.1, -39.3, -40.3 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its prior-28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -35.0 throughout.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays at or above 5.5 while WORKPLACES sits below -18, households are still routing weekday time and spending to the home and immediate neighbourhood, crowding out discretionary retail trips; the joint condition drives RETAIL_REC down over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean >= 5.5 and WORKPLACES weekly mean <= -18.0 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL held 5.6-6.6 while WORKPLACES ranged -12.3 to -21.0
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL >= 5.5 and WORKPLACES <= -18.0 jointly hold, RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is higher than its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-winter PARKS readings of -33 to -39 mark outdoor leisure being abandoned for climate-controlled indoor venues, and part of that displaced activity lands in shopping centres and entertainment precincts, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS weekly means -35.0, -37.3, -33.1, -38.6 in the four weeks to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the 14 days after 2022-07-15 is lower than over the prior 14 days while PARKS remains below -30.0.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM rose to +1.7, its highest reading in four weeks and the only category at or above baseline, while RETAIL_REC fell to -15.0; this divergence shows household budgets being reallocated to essentials, which suppresses discretionary retail spending over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean >= 0.0 while RETAIL_REC weekly mean <= -12.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its prior-28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays at or above baseline and RETAIL_REC stays below -12.0.

mechanism_narrative: The office-return rebound is one week old and fragile; if the WORKPLACES weekly mean crosses back below -20.0 the commuting channel collapses again and RETAIL_REC declines within one week because weekday retail trips are cancelled immediately.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean crosses below -20.0 after a reading above -18.0
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -21.0 at t-1w before recovering to -15.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: After WORKPLACES crosses below -20.0, RETAIL_REC over the following 7 days is at or above its level in the 7 days preceding the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: With no capacity limits or mobility mandates binding in Victoria, the only remaining policy drag is case-isolation keeping infected workers at home; as RESIDENTIAL drops below 6.0 the policy drag eases and RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL eased from 6.6 at t-2w and t-1w to 6.1 at t-0w
regime_hint: post-restriction policy steady state with case isolation only
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is at or below its prior-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains below 6.0 and no new statewide restriction is visible in RESIDENTIAL.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS is the most volatile series in the panel and any rebound above -33.0 signals households substituting outdoor socialising for indoor commercial leisure, which subtracts from RETAIL_REC in the following week rather than adding to it.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above -33.0 from below -36.0
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS swung from -37.3 at t-2w up to -33.1 at t-1w then back to -38.6 at t-0w
regime_hint: outdoor-leisure substitution under mild winter conditions
failure_condition: In the 7 days after PARKS crosses above -33.0, RETAIL_REC is higher than in the 7 days before the crossing.
